Absolutely the best toothbrush I have ever used. My teeth feel so clean when After brushing and I am a 3 time a day or more brusher. But with these my teeth and mouth feel cleaner than any of the other organic toothbrushes I have used. Also they are very soft to the gums & teeth but not so soft that they flatten out & make you feel like your just wasting your time. They do the job & protect your gums & teeth. I didn't notice I was brushing hard so using these toothbrushes with extra soft bristles prevent me from brushing too hard even if I tried. You do have to be extra vigilant about brushing into the crevices though because if I take a closer look sometimes I still see plaque residue left on my teeth so I go in and brush again.

reviews.t: Bristle hair toothbrush versus the ordinary kinds
reviews.x: This toothbrush is entirely different from other ordinary toothbrushes. If you have sensitive teeth or gum, then switching to this extra soft toothbrush makes a huge difference. By using this brush, it is as if you’re massaging your teeth and gum rather than brushing them, while at the same time you’re cleaning your teeth. I’ll highly recommend getting bristle hair toothbrushes like this. Try it for yourself, then you’ll see the difference.

These are what I’ve been looking for. The bristles are so soft but still clean really well due to the density. The brush thoroughly scrubs my teeth without harming my gums. The brush head is nice and small unlike some I’ve tried in the past where the head is so big I couldn’t get to my back teeth very well. All and all I’m happy with this find.

reviews.t: Good for sensitive teeth and gums
reviews.x: Seem very well made. The two factors that led me to buy this one were the soft micro bristles, and the fact that its bpa free. Also has a smaller brush head than the previous ones I was using which is especially important if you have wisdom teeth and/or a small mouth (I have both) so you can get way back there easier. Best brush I've ever used!

These are almost too soft. They feel great on my sensitive teeth and gums and is definitely comfortable to brush with these. However I feel like my teeth aren’t clean after brushing. I brush for a normal amount of time, around two minutes, but feel like I have to brush much longer with these to get my teeth feeling clean.

reviews.t: Great for sensitive teeth and gums

I tried oral b, Colgate... before, they all too big for me. This is the perfect size and softness t me!! If u can’t find one fits you, I highly recommend you tried this one.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brushes as very soft and gentle on sensitive teeth and gums, with many citing reduced irritation or bleeding.
Many reviewers say the soft bristles still clean teeth effectively, though a few feel the brushes are too soft to leave teeth feeling clean.
Several reviewers highlight the small brush head and dense bristles as helpful for reaching back teeth and small mouths.
A few reviewers mention durability or value concerns, including brushes wearing out quickly and being pricey.
One reviewer reports receiving only two brushes instead of four and a chemical smell.
